videoTitle: Why You Can't Sit Cross-Legged (It's Not What You Think)
videoDescription: Struggling to sit cross-legged without your knees sticking up? It's not about flexibility—it's about hip rotation and which muscles are actually restricting the movement. Find out which four stretches target the real problem at mindtivate.com
script: You've been told you're not flexible enough to sit cross-legged. But it's not about flexibility at all—it's about external rotation, and specifically which muscles are pulling your femur back in the socket...
Visit mindtivate.com to find the answer.
thumbnailConcept: A close-up shot of a person sitting on a wooden living room floor trying to sit cross-legged, but one of their knees is stubbornly propped high in the air, stiff and unable to lower. They are leaning forward with a look of quiet frustration, one hand pressing down firmly on their elevated knee in a futile attempt to push it flat.
